children: Kuehne + Nagel's long-term Amazon partnership is consistent with the company's efforts to deepen its relationships with customers, analysts at J.P. Morgan say in a note. Amazon has reportedly made similar agreements with other key suppliers, such as Qualcomm, to ensure it captures secondary benefits from expansion plans, the analysts say. The deal overall will likely be supportive of K+N's business, with the air logistics area benefiting the most, while remaining cautious on its sea logistics exposure, they say. Kuehne + Nagel shares are up 5.3% at 227.30 Swiss francs. (aimee.look@wsj.com)
